spell.arcanes_oublies.gold_bolt.guide: Hurl a spinning golden ingot that bursts into razor-sharp shards on impact, hurting everything nearby.
spell.arcanes_oublies.gilded_chains.guid: Golden chains burst out of the ground and pin your target in place.
death.attack.gold_magic.item: %1$s was turned to gold by %2$s using %3$s
spell.arcanes_oublies.goldfall.guide: Massive golden ingots rain from the sky around the targeted spot, crushing everything they land on.
spell.arcanes_oublies.golden_spikes.guid: A wave of gold crystal spikes bursts out of the ground in front of you, tossing enemies into the air.
spell.arcanes_oublies.midas_curse.guide: Your target slowly turns to gold, slower and slower until it freezes into a golden statue that shatters.
spell.arcanes_oublies.aurum_blade.guide: A giant golden sword forms in the sky above your target and plunges into it.
spell.arcanes_oublies.molten_torrent.gui: Pour a stream of molten gold that burns your enemies and leaves glowing pools behind.
spell.arcanes_oublies.gilded_armor.guide: Coat yourself in liquid gold: more armor, and part of every hit you take goes back to the attacker.
spell.arcanes_oublies.golden_sentinels.g: Summon golden knights that guard you and fight your enemies for a while.
spell.arcanes_oublies.sun_of_eldorado.gu: Raise a golden sun above you. It burns every nearby enemy with its beams, then collapses in a huge golden explosion.
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.midas_curse: %1$s was turned to gold by %2$s and shattered
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.gilded_armo: %1$s hit %2$s's golden armor a little too hard
death.attack.arcanes_oublies.sun_of_eldo: %1$s was burned away by %2$s's Sun of Eldorado
